Delivery and completed issue closure require the owner's exact-head decision and the post-merge readbacks described below.

## Identity and controlled environment

- Base/main: `9d1bffe009e802f626344ebd863269e637d948e4`; candidate source/docs/fixtures: `bfd676b642421e705a6a2936e9d12b7a86870b34`.

- The original audit's runtime hash is historical. Current compatible font-loading changes are disclosed in [source comparison](qualification/source-since-audit.diff); the accepted prayer admission, cache, formatter, model, arc, loader and render-loop owners are byte-identical. No runtime owner is modified by this PR.

- Ordinary cases use fixed `2026-09-07T12:00:00Z`, UTC, 24.47/39.61, method4/school0. Tromsø cases use the original captured envelopes, 69.6492/18.9553, method3, Europe/Oslo, and the original summer/winter epochs. The display label is an inert fixture label.

## Native evidence and contrary observations

[Case index](cases.json) selects 72 acquisitions and retains two contrary acquisitions. [Manifest](manifest.json) binds the original native videos, raw traces, exact case inputs, source/observed hashes, browser identity and decoded PNGs. Large raw JSON is gzip-compressed with deterministic mtime; independent review receipts remain directly readable. Decompression recovers the original bytes except the explicitly declared browser executable path projection. Local browser paths are replaced by basename and binary hash; original receipt hashes remain bound.

Each `browser/<engine>/<case>/native.webm` is the original recording. `first-presented-candidate.png` and its strip are locator outputs, not automatic acceptance. Ten headed Firefox locator images catch row backgrounds before text is present; the [independent frame associations](qualification/independent-review/native-frame-associations.json) identify the earliest actual prayer-text frames and their incomplete predecessors. The intervening native frames were inspected and contain no earlier prayer text. No later endpoint replaces a wrong first prayer presentation. Ingress recovery retains the stronger earliest recovered render receipt. All 46 raw `PARTIAL_FIRST_PRESENTATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED` statuses remain unchanged where a capture request crossed a render ordinal; all completed prayer-render tuples and the original native sequence were reviewed together. A later AH badge is not asserted byte-identical to the first footer.

The added distinct storage-denial control initially used a generic held prayer rule. Warm-cache adoption requested tomorrow first, consuming that hold; the current refresh then completed unheld. Those two acquisitions are retained under `contrary/` and are rejected by the [strengthened rule-identity control](qualification/day-binding-negative-control.json). The correction binds the existing rules to September7 current and September8 prefetch. Only that added case was reacquired. The corrected first presentation shows cached04:47, then the actual visible timetable shows05:03 while the raw cached bytes stay unchanged. This was a fixture routing error, not a demonstrated product admission bug.

[Preparation provenance](qualification/preparation-reuse.json) retains the sealed worker's 33 case preparations and receipt hashes. Preparation is not acceptance. Native proof comes from this execution; the existing R0007 runner, observer and headed Firefox correction are reused unchanged. [Trace-verifier negative controls](qualification/trace-verifier-controls.json) retain rejection of early writes, wrong zone, substituted recovery ordinal, blank timetable, early retry and page errors. Original source mutants remain in the unchanged source suite and the [accepted audit](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/b879573c298f19189d1f2392108b8b9f3b2cda0b/docs/rlgwo-audit/20261008/workers/A/02-assessment.json).

## Preservation and limits

The reused R0007 controls bind all 135 runtime files, exact control inputs/configuration, observer output, browser executable and 91 retained files. Chromium uses its accepted native controls; Firefox uses only the accepted headed replacements. The rejected R0007 headless recordings remain excluded. Default live30s, reduced preference, forced full motion and the warm opaque ashen below-horizon Moon are separate qualified controls. They do not claim a new whole-scene startup or astronomical science qualification.

Passed prayer rows retain their existing lower contrast; compact polar/date values can retain ellipses. Full optional-date explanations are inspected in the actual dialog. No runtime, prayer calculation, provider, schema, cache namespace, installation, Moon, sky, settings or frozen V1 source changes are introduced. This packet closes no other RLGWO.

## Reserved delivery

[Closure-certificate state](closure-certificate.json) keeps qualification separate from delivery. After approval of the exact reviewed PR head, merge that head, verify the published README and evidence plus served runtime bytes, repeat the cheap public consumer readback in isolated profiles, publish and read back the individual `CLOSE-R0002` certificate, close #2 as `completed`, and independently read back its final GitHub state. `Implements #2` deliberately does not auto-close the issue on merge.
